support.privacy.accountEmail: • Sɛ wopaw sɛ wobɛyɛ akawnt a, wɔde wo email di dwuma ma sign-in ne akawnt a wɔsan de ba.

support.privacy.location: • Bere a PickupRadar abue no, wɔde beae di dwuma de kyerɛ pickup mmea a ɛbɛn. Bere a wode twɛn amaneɛbɔ mena no, wɔde wo beae mena sɛnea wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wowɔ {distance} a ɛbɛn pickup beae no mu. Wɔnkora saa coordinates no, na PickupRadar mfa background beae tracking nni dwuma.
support.privacy.locationOfflineQueue: • Bere a PickupRadar abue no, wɔde beae di dwuma de kyerɛ mmeae a ɛbɛn a wɔde nneɛma bɛfa. Wubetumi nso ahwehwɛ nneɛma mu a wunni baabi a wowɔ. Sɛ wopɛ live wait ne venue-status amanneɛbɔ a, wɔde wo beae no di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ wowɔ {distance} a ɛwɔ pickup point no mu. Wɔnkora coordinates a wɔde di dwuma ma saa nhwehwɛmu yi so wɔ wait-report kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow mu. Sɛ wɔantumi ansoma amanneɛbɔ a wɔde twɛn ntɛm ara a, wobetumi de asie wo fon so ne ne coordinates ama woasan asɔ ahwɛ. Wɔmfa amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ahyɛ ntonto mu a adi boro simma 15 nkɔma, na wɔyi amanneɛbɔ a wɔakora so ne ne nsusuwii ahorow no fi hɔ bere a PickupRadar hwɛ ntonto no akyi. PickupRadar ntumi nhwɛ baabi a wowɔ wɔ akyi.
